variant.title: Little Killer Sudoku
variant.description: Each outside diagonal clue gives the sum of the digits on its diagonal ray.
rule_guide.title: Little Killer Sudoku
rule_guide.item_1: Each outside number and inward diagonal arrow identifies one diagonal ray.
rule_guide.item_2: Add every digit on that ray. The total must equal the outside number.
rule_guide.item_3: A digit may belong to more than one ray, so it must satisfy every clue that crosses its cell.
